question.text: What is the admission process and tuition fees at BIS Hanoi?

input.content: What is the admission process and tuition fees at BIS Hanoi?

content.text:
**British International School (BIS) Hanoi** (part of Nord Anglia Education) is a selective, co-educational day school for ages 2–18 that welcomes students of all nationalities. Fees below are for the **2026–27** academic year and are in Vietnamese Dong (VND), as published on the school’s website. Confirm current details directly with the school, as figures and policies can change.

### Admission process
The school aims to complete the process from first contact to an offer in **no more than about two weeks**, depending on how quickly you apply. Responses to enquiries are typically within 24 hours on working days (Monday–Friday). Students can join at any time during the year if places are available; otherwise they may join a waiting list. Siblings of current students receive priority, and families with three or more children enrolled get a **10% discount** on the youngest child’s tuition.

Typical steps:

1. **Enquiry** — Submit the online enquiry form (or call/email). The admissions team guides you through the process.
2. **Campus tour** — In person in Hanoi or virtual.
3. **Application and documents** — Complete the online application and pay the non-refundable **Application Fee of 4,500,000 VND** (covers the entrance assessment). Supporting documents generally include:
   - Signed Admissions Terms and Conditions
   - Most recent school records in English (translated if needed)
   - Learning support assessment documents (if applicable)
   - Digital passport-style photo
   - Copy of the child’s passport or birth certificate
   - Medical and immunisation records
   - Physical evaluation signed by a doctor
4. **Assessment and interview** — Age-appropriate; available online if the family is overseas. Examples:
   - Foundation 1–3: class observation
   - Year 1: EAL test, class observation, and interview
   - Year 2: CAT4, EAL test, class observation, and interview
   - Years 3–6: writing test, CAT, EAL assessment, and interview with Head of Primary
   - Years 7–12: writing test, Cambridge Insight test, EAL assessment, and interview with Head of Secondary
5. **Offer and acceptance** — A written offer includes the start date and terms. You generally have **two weeks** to accept. Acceptance is confirmed only after payment of the registration fee. If a class is full, you can join the waiting list.

English is the language of instruction. The school assesses whether it can meet the child’s needs and offers English as an Additional Language (EAL) support where appropriate (an additional fee may apply in some cases—confirm with admissions). Placement is based mainly on age (birth-date bands) plus academic level, maturity, and English ability.

**Official pages:** [Admissions](https://www.nordangliaeducation.com/bis-hanoi/admissions) and [Entry requirements](https://www.nordangliaeducation.com/bis-hanoi/admissions/entry-requirements).

### Tuition and related fees (2026–27)
**One-time fees**
- **Application fee:** 4,500,000 VND (non-refundable), paid with the application.
- **Registration fee** (non-refundable, paid once on acceptance to secure the place): 23,600,000 VND (Foundation) or 70,800,000 VND (Primary and Secondary). The difference may be payable when a child moves from Foundation into Primary.
- **Security deposit:** 23,600,000 VND (refundable), for Primary and Secondary students and for children moving from Foundation into Primary. Returned when the child leaves, provided you give **90 days’ written notice**.

**Annual tuition fees (VND)**  
These include uniforms, daily lunches, snacks (Early Years and Primary), learning materials and equipment, day trips, mandatory secondary international exams, and after-school co-curricular activities (CCAs) run by school staff. They do **not** include overnight residential trips. Termly payment options are also published (often higher than the annual rate). A full schedule PDF is available on the fees page.

| Year group | Annual fee (VND) |
|---|---|
| F1 – Full day | 343,100,000 |
| F1 – Half day | 253,600,000 |
| F2 – Full day | 360,900,000 |
| F3 – Full day | 510,800,000 |
| Year 1 | 657,600,000 |
| Years 2–4 | 715,500,000 |
| Years 5–6 | 734,600,000 |
| Years 7–9 | 846,800,000 |
| Years 10–11 | 893,200,000 |
| Years 12–13 | 970,200,000 |

Year-group placement follows published birth-date ranges (for example, F1 full/half day is typically for children born 1 Sep 2023–31 Aug 2024 for 2026–27). Check the school’s fee schedule for exact bands and termly breakdowns.

**Source:** [BIS Hanoi tuition fees page](https://www.nordangliaeducation.com/bis-hanoi/admissions/tuition-fees).

For the latest figures, availability, or company-sponsored fee arrangements, contact the BIS Hanoi admissions team via the enquiry form on their website.
